name: Ham Ninh crab
summary: Boiled crab from Hàm Ninh, dipped in lime and pepper. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam calls it ghẹ luộc, red, with firm meat, and the dip muối tiêu chanh. The specialty-seafood account calls the crab rosy speckled and says smaller crabs carry more flavour. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Hàm Ninh, Phu Quoc. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says the village is 20 km northeast of Dương Đông. The specialty-seafood account says 20 km from Duong Dong town. Both distances stay.
taste: Firm meat on the Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam account, dipped in muối tiêu chanh. Fragrant and aromatic on the specialty-seafood account, dipped in lime and pepper sauce. That account says the smaller crab has more flavour.
howToEat: Eat it boiled, at the village, with the sea wind. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says a visit without this crab has missed the village, and that crab is there almost all the time.
The specialty-seafood account also says the crab is served in other places on the island, and sends you to Hàm Ninh for the shore. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Làng chài Hàm Ninh. 20 km northeast of Dương Đông on the Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam account, and 20 km from Duong Dong town on the specialty-seafood account. A single door is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ghe Ham Ninh — boiled crab on Phu Quoc
seoDescription: Ghẹ Hàm Ninh is boiled and dipped in lime and pepper. One account says 20 km northeast of Dương Đông. A price is Check on arrival.
